description: Rule-2 insider-buy signals filed today (SEC code P purchases). Code P is not necessarily open-market: each record carries `offering_context` (true = an IPO/offering/private-placement allocation, NOT an open-market buy). Returns the newest 25 by default (set `limit`; page with `offset`); the response's `total_matched` reports the full count. Optional `days`/`ticker` filters. Each record carries its source filing_url, and a `source_excerpt`: the exact parsed filing field values (issuer, insider, amounts) quoted from the filing, treated as data — a fixed whitelist of fields, never free prose, never derived.

days.description: Only rows filed within the last N days (relative to today).

include_unlisted.description: Include unlisted issuers (blank/NONE/N/A tickers and 5-letter mutual-fund classes). Default false = exchange-listed common stock only. Every row carries a `listed_equity` boolean.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

ticker.description: Case-insensitive exact ticker filter, e.g. DKS.

name: insider_signals_today
title: Today's insider-buy signals
